s.note: a slow Sunday in the city
s.how: Whip 250g cream cheese with a splash of milk until light. Split and toast 4 bagels. Spread thickly, then layer with 200g smoked salmon, a few capers, paper-thin red onion and dill sprigs. Cut in half and serve on a board.

s.note: the restaurant where the film opens, with everyone talking at once
s.how: Slice 1 baguette into 20 rounds, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Whip 200g ricotta with lemon zest and top 10 with it and a drizzle of honey. Fry 200g sliced mushrooms with thyme and garlic and pile on the other 10 with shaved parmesan.

m.note: Isaac and Tracy watching old movies
m.how: Marinate 700g diced chicken thigh in 2 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp cornflour. Fry hot with 10 dried chillies and 1 tsp Sichuan pepper. Add sauce of 2 tbsp black vinegar, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp Shaoxing, then 80g peanuts and spring onion. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: a classic for the city Isaac can't stop loving
w.how: Crush 200g plain biscuits with 80g melted butter, press into a 20cm tin and bake 10 minutes at 160C. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs, 150g sour cream, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon. Pour in, bake at 150C for 60 minutes, cool in the oven with the door ajar and chill overnight.

d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml rye, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over plenty of ice for 30 seconds. Strain into a chilled coupe and drop in a cocktail cherry. Makes four, so make them one or two at a time.
